facts.en: Event volunteer at Saffron Bridge Puzzle Club, 2024–2025.
facts.zh: 2024—2025年任藏红花桥益智俱乐部赛事志愿者。

facts.en: On the fictional Rookleaf puzzle ladder, historical peak rating was 2180 in May 2023; current rating as of September 2025 was 1920.
facts.zh: 在虚构的车叶益智积分榜上，历史最高积分为2023年5月的2180；截至2025年9月当前积分为1920。

job_description.en: Puzzle tournament coordinator: track standings and support competitive events.
job_description.zh: 益智赛事协调员：追踪排名并支持竞技活动。
